name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_years_since_menarche_value_recorded_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the number of years since the patient experienced menarche, in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the number of years since menarche is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of years since the patient experienced menarche, as recorded in years.

name: patient_finding_of_body_mass_index_value_recorded_now_withunit_kilograms_per_square_meter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current body mass index (BMI) in kilograms per square meter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no current BMI measurement in kilograms per square meter is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured BMI value if a current measurement in kilograms per square meter is available.

name: patient_has_undergone_ultrasonography_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has undergone ultrasonography (ultrasound examination) now.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has undergone ultrasonography (ultrasound examination) now.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not undergone ultrasonography (ultrasound examination) now.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has undergone ultrasonography (ultrasound examination) now.

name: patient_measure_of_duration_of_menstrual_cycle_value_recorded_now_withunit_days

when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's menstrual cycle length is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the measured or reported value in days if the patient's menstrual cycle length is currently known or can be determined.

name: patient_has_regular_menstrual_cycles_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient currently has regular menstrual cycles (cycle length between 21 and 35 days inclusive).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's menstrual cycle length is between 21 and 35 days inclusive, indicating regular cycles.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's menstrual cycle length is outside the 21-35 day range, indicating irregular cycles.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's menstrual cycle length is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: patient_time_since_menarche_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of years since the patient experienced menarche, recorded in years at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the number of years since menarche is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of years since the patient experienced menarche, as of the current time, if this information is available.
